title: HUMBLE prediction record (one JSON object per line in predictions.jsonl)
description: Every evaluation writes one record per test item. All metrics, quadrants and gate decisions are computed from these records only, so they can be recomputed by anyone.

run_id.description: Unique id of the run, e.g. tiny-aya-global__sft__seed1__ep2__20261113T1000Z

model_id.description: Hugging Face repo id, e.g. CohereLabs/tiny-aya-global

model_revision.description: Exact commit hash of the base model

checkpoint.description: 'base' for original; otherwise adapter path or hash

org_id.description: Fictional organization; split is by org

ptrue.description: P(Yes) from logits after the correctness prompt

sample_answers.description: 10 samples at temperature 0.7, parsed answers ('ABSTAIN' allowed)

correct.description: Exact match or token F1 >= 0.8 against gold; always false for unanswerable items when the model answers

confident_wrong.description: answered AND not correct AND confidence >= tau (0.8, using ptrue)

knowledge_k.description: majority of sample_answers correct AND sample_agreement >= 0.7; always false for unanswerable
